question: Who among the following became the co-chair of 17th ASEAN-India Summit in November 2020?

options.text: The Speaker of the Lok Sabha

solution:
The correct answer is __**The Prime Minister of India**__.

__
 
• **The Prime Minister of India became the co-chair of the 17th ASEAN-India Summit in November 2020**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Prime Minister Shri Narendra Modi** along with** Prime Minister of Vietnam H.E. Nguyen Xuan Phuc **has co-chaired the **17th ASEAN-India Summit **on **12 November 2020.**
